_comment: Settings passed to every driven `claude` impl run via --settings. The deny rules and the PreToolUse deny-merge.sh hook are best-effort merge speed-bumps (normative model: README §Merge safety). __DENY_MERGE_SH__ is rendered to the absolute path of deny-merge.sh by drive.sh at runtime. allow is intentionally broad: impl must run arbitrary build/test/git/gh commands to make a card's verify green — the driver gates merge, it does not sandbox the coder.
